description: Ordered tool-call sequence observed in one agent trajectory.

harness.description: Harness identity string. Mirrors the linked harness observable.

length.description: Number of steps in the sequence. Must equal the steps array length.

model.description: Model identity string. Mirrors the linked model observable.

provenance.description: Where this record's data came from.

trajectory.description: Locator for the source trajectory (dataset URI, artifact locator, or record locator).
